workflow.task_summary: Normalize public-repository metadata TSV into a FASTQ sample-sheet CSV preserving sample/run identifiers, layout, predicted FASTQ paths, and organism metadata; no read-path validation is performed because reads were not uploaded.

steps.reason: Convert the uploaded TSV metadata into a canonical FASTQ sample sheet while retaining sample and run identifiers, single/paired layout, predicted FASTQ paths, and organism metadata. The corresponding reads are not present, so path validation is intentionally omitted.
